# CPH2865_16.0.8.301(EX01)

> 官方更新日志 · 来源: 官方 changelog 页面
> OTA 指纹: `CPH2865_11.A.33_0330_202606172123`
> 原文: https://gauss-componentotamanual.allawnofs.com/remove-9d356eb093be66ce6a8b165bbddaa7dd/component-ota/26/07/29/3bb3f6c8f05f439c9a492f63b4d1bd92.html

### Every detail covered

Introduces the AI Remix Collage feature, allowing you to extract subjects from videos and save them as animated stickers. You can apply these animated stickers to videos, motion photos or still photos to create new videos, or add animated outlines for more creative designs.
You can now connect your phone to two pairs of Bluetooth earphones at the same time and adjust their volumes independently, so you can share music and films with others.
The Weather app's homepage now displays moonrise, moonset and lunar phase details, helping you stay up-to-date with the moon's phases and schedule.
Adds support for quick app switching in Outdoor mode. You can now pin your frequently used apps to the bottom status bar for easier switching.
Game Capture now supports 2K screenshots, preserving more details. You can find this feature in "Game Assistant - Tools - Game Capture - 2K Hyper Resolution screenshot".
Improves the Categories view in the app drawer by adding an "App suggestions" category that intelligently recommends your most-used apps for quicker access.

### Security & privacy

You can now turn off "Accessibility" permissions with just one tap. If apps from outside official stores attempt risky actions, you'll get a notification so you can instantly revoke the relevant permission.
Integrates the June 2026 Android security patch to enhance system security.

Updates for customised devices

This update includes one or more of the following: apps, wallpapers, ringtones, startup animations, Home screen layout and network settings.

You can now choose from more custom fingerprint icons and animations. You can find this feature in "Settings - Home screen, Lock screen & style - More - Fingerprint animation".

### Camera & Photos

Adds the "Primrose" filter, which produces warm, delicate skin tones in portraits and effortlessly evokes a vintage film aesthetic.
Adds the "Bold B&W" filter, specifically designed for documentary photography. Its striking high-contrast light and shadow layers create a powerful visual impact.

### Games

You can now use the equaliser to adjust game sound effects, creating your own sound style and experiencing gaming audio tailored to your preferences. You can find this feature in "Game Assistant - Tools - Sound boost - Equaliser".

You can now lock your PC remotely with one tap. Once your phone is connected to your PC remotely, you can unlock it directly on your phone without entering your PC's password.
